video.decoding_capability: Live view 4 channels of 720p or 2 channels of 1080p via HDMI or VGA output

features: Recording: up to 16 channels of 720p (1280x720) or 8 channels of 1080p (1920x1080)
Up to 4TB internal storage from 2 hard drives (not included)
Remote live viewing: datasheet states up to 16 channels via HTTP/HTTPS, user manual states up to 24 cameras (sources conflict)
Power supply: datasheet states Output 12V/2A 36W, user manual states 12V/5A 60W (sources conflict); input 100~240V 50/60Hz
Video compression: H.264 baseline, main or high profile; audio G.711 (u-Law and a-Law), synchronized audio and video recording
Recording modes: continuous, schedule, event triggered or manual
Motion detection with up to 16 motion detection target areas; intelligent search by time & date and motion
Supports Grandstream GXV36xx cameras, GXV35xx encoders/decoders and third-party ONVIF compliant cameras; ONVIF 2.2
1x RCA line-in, 1x RCA line-out, 2x USB 2.0, no eSATA
